seo.title: About Tibet417 | Tibetan & Himalayan Fashion in Switzerland
seo.description: Tibet417 Fashion brings authentic Tibetan and Himalayan clothing and accessories to customers in Switzerland. Learn who we are and how we source our collection.

tagline: Where the Soul of the Himalayas Embraces Swiss Elegance
intro1: At Tibet417, we believe that true luxury is never just worn — it is deeply felt. It is a quiet confidence, a comforting warmth, and a reflection of who you truly are.
intro2: Born in the heart of Switzerland, we are a small, devoted team united by a single, beautiful vision: to weave the rich, timeless heritage of Tibetan culture into the sleek, sophisticated lines of modern Western fashion. We know your style is as dynamic as your life — it breathes, it shifts, and it evolves right alongside you.
missionText: Our mission is simple yet deeply personal: to fulfill your unique wishes, elevate your personal style, and help you look and feel your absolute best. Every piece we create is designed to move with grace, honoring age-old traditions while boldly embracing the rhythm of today's world.

craftsmanship.label: Enduring Craftsmanship:
craftsmanship.text: Every garment is a labor of love, created to feel like a second skin. We source only the finest, most durable materials so that your favorite pieces stay with you through every season of life.

accessibility.label: Luxury Within Reach:
accessibility.text: We believe that exceptional quality and soulful design should be accessible. By keeping our values close and our standards high, we deliver true luxury at a price that honors your investment.

journey.label: A Journey We Share:
journey.text: To us, you are never just a transaction — you are a cherished part of our story. Whether you are stepping out for a grand moment or seeking comfort in the everyday, we are here to support your personal expression with empathy, warmth, and unwavering dedication.

swissIntro: Proudly rooted in Switzerland, we want your journey with Tibet417 to be as seamless, comforting, and transparent as the clothes you wear.

pricing.label: Honest Pricing:
pricing.text: Every price is thoughtfully presented in CHF, fully inclusive of Swiss VAT, ensuring absolute clarity from the moment you fall in love with a piece.

delivery.label: Swift, Reliable Delivery:
delivery.text: Every order is lovingly packaged and dispatched directly within Switzerland via trusted local post or courier, bringing a touch of Himalayan grace straight to your doorstep.

closing: Thank you for welcoming us into your wardrobe, your milestones, and your quiet everyday moments. We are deeply honored to walk this path — and this life — alongside you.
